row.stop_reason: No exercise contrast in the sequenced samples. All 10 GSE199111 samples are CTX-injured TA at day 6 from sedentary mice; the only factor is genotype (wild type 5 vs miR-501 -/- 5). The paper's exercise experiment (eccentric treadmill, S2.5.p1, Table 1) was assessed by Evans blue dye histology only and was never sequenced. The request's estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) cannot be identified from these data; the genotype contrast does not answer it and is not substituted.
